long_biography.plain_text:
After medical training at the Medical College of Georgia and Emory University, Oskouei practiced anesthesiology, pain medicine and interventional spine care. In 2013, he founded Ortho Sport & Spine Physicians to combine minimally invasive treatment with a more individualized patient experience.

Oskouei remained the practice's sole owner as it developed an affiliated ambulatory surgery center and expanded into a national network of clinics and imaging facilities. His work has also included research and a neuromonitoring system designed to protect nerves during endoscopic spinal procedures. Beyond healthcare, he established investment and family-office entities and a private foundation supporting environmental, humanitarian, human-rights and healthcare initiatives.
